identities.label: Pamunkey
identities.description: ethnic group and federally-recognized Native American tribe
identities.summary:
The Pamunkey Indian Tribe is a federally recognized tribe of Pamunkey people in Virginia. They control the Pamunkey Indian Reservation in King William County, Virginia. Historically, they spoke the Pamunkey language.
They are one of 11 Native American tribes in Virginia and an Indigenous people of the Northeastern Woodlands.
